description: jQuery is a JavaScript library used by many existing websites. It gives short tools for selecting page parts and handling events. Learn what those tools do, then see how similar jobs work with the browser DOM. Use a local HTML page that loads jQuery 3.7 before these scripts. Examples need that library; the plain playground does not include it. Put the script after the example markup.
versionNote: Uses stable jQuery 3.7 APIs for maintaining existing sites.
whatYouWillLearn: Learn to change the reminder words
Learn to type another name before clicking
Learn to add a second child button after the handler is attached
